fact: AIP reports UNDP handed over the UniPod, a digital fabrication and innovation centre at Lycee technique de Cocody, Abidjan, open to startups to prototype, with no incubation cohort programme stated.

Ivory Coast's digital ministry launched the Ivoire Tech Next 15 and Ivoire Tech Scale Up programmes on 29 July 2026 for 15 startups and 15 SMEs over 24 months, with applications open until 13 September.
Diallo says the national innovation hub IvorTech, in Abidjan's Plateau district, has an on-site incubator that only recently started operations.

The Ministry of Digital Transition's draft 2025 budget funds FCFA 1,000,405,177 to develop the Grand-Bassam free zone (ZBTIC) to host ICT companies, and FCFA 500 million to attract 100 ICT and biotechnology firms to it.

The Ministry of Digital Transition selected 32 firms from over 150 applicants on 4 November 2026 for 24 months of support in the Ivoire Tech Next 15 (14 firms) and Ivoire Tech Scale Up (18 firms) programmes.
